answer: Tenure is a chained deposit. A key's proof at epoch n hashes its proof at n-1 plus a signed nonce, so each epoch it posts 200 POA and every proof down the river verifies in order; one skipped epoch breaks the chain and restarts tenure at zero. The vault escrows each deposit for 12 clean epochs and forfeits it on a failed audit. A lagoon of fifty fresh keys buys fifty separate chains, each clone paying the full sum of its predecessors: twelve epochs costs 15,600 POA per clone, and no key borrows another's history. Keys sharing a funding source are slashed jointly and their deposits burned.
